• Tsinghua University
    • Department of Automotive Engineering: strong in internal combustion engines, new energy vehicles and intelligent vehicles. During my PhD I read some of their papers on vehicle pass-by noise.
Department of Automotive Engineering, Tsinghua University
  • Shanghai Jiao Tong University: its strengths are internal combustion engines and mechanical engineering
Institute of Vibration, Shock and Noise, Shanghai Jiao Tong University
  • Tianjin University: I just had a look, and with electric vehicles sweeping in, they’ve been working on EVs since 2011
Welcome to the website of the Internal Combustion Engine Research Institute, Tianjin University!
  • Zhejiang University: home to the only top-grade comprehensive vehicle proving ground at any Chinese university
Institute of Power Machinery and Vehicular EngineeringAutomotive and Engine Noise and Vibration Lab, Zhejiang University
  • Tongji University: new energy vehicles, aerodynamics and NVH
School of Automotive Studies, Tongji University
  • Jilin University:
State Key Laboratory of Automotive Simulation and Control, Jilin University
  • Beijing Institute of Technology: Institute of Vibration and Noise Control
School of Mechanical and Vehicular Engineering, Beijing Institute of Technology
  • Chongqing University
About the College of Automotive Engineering, Chongqing University
  • Hunan University:
Automotive laboratory, Hunan University
  • Wuhan University of Technology: several schools are joining forces on electric vehicles. Another strength is automotive component manufacturing
Welcome to the School of Automotive Engineering, Wuhan University of Technology
  • Jiangsu University (Jiangsu Province has many NVH firms and automotive suppliers)
Institute of Noise and Vibration, School of Automotive and Traffic Engineering, Jiangsu University
  • Hubei University of Automotive Technology: historical ties to the Second Automobile Works (now Dongfeng Motor)
Research institutes, Hubei University of Automotive Technology
  • Chang’an University: has a vehicle proving ground and a wind tunnel lab, and is fairly well known in the bus and coach industry
School of Automobile, Chang’an University
  • Hefei University of Technology: publishes a lot of academic papers
Institute of Noise and Vibration Engineering, School of Mechanical Engineering, Hefei University of Technology
  • South China University of Technology: good at engine mount matching, with close ties to GAC (Guangzhou Automobile Group)
Department of Automotive Engineering

Excerpted from a Zhihu Live talk by @linmue (Xiangjun Tan)
